ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.4.2 (TieJin Modify) 双版本目录与1.7凝胶外观更新：1.6保留2.4.1冻结基线，1.7独立加载本版内容，共享基础贴图。升级时完整替换旧模组文件夹，不要合并版本目录。 1.7修复凝胶化过程重复结算、材质和线程兼容；原生Shader柔化黑边，统一身体、头部和SizedApparel的光照响应，稳定材质缓存减少重复工作。原版保护眼部，Facial Animation保留五官动画与遮挡。 完全凝胶化角色在“调教”ITab的“凝胶外观”区设置个人渲染、颜色和透明度。默认深紫、HSV饱和度90%、不透明度85%，支持恢复默认配色；关闭保留设置，旧档一次继承原全局选择。不再添加重复的命令栏调色按钮。 保留2.4.1的PNA重置、欢愉恩赐、主人资格与成长、绑定维护、六种特化及人格凝胶玩法。Harmony与RJW先于SSC加载，契约仪式需要Ideology。兔入口仍禁用，旧RimTalk对接暂停。 版本与验收边界见CHANGELOG.md及Docs/Releases/2.4.2/。
Version 2.4.2 — versioned runtime layout and 1.7 gel appearance. RimWorld 1.6 retains the frozen SSC 2.4.1 runtime; 1.7 loads the new content separately with shared baseline textures. Replace the old mod folder when upgrading; do not merge version directories. Native gel shaders soften dark outlines, align body/head/SA lighting and reuse stable material variants. Vanilla eyes are protected; FA facial animation and occlusion are preserved. Fully gelatinized pawns use the Training tab for per-pawn rendering, RGB/HSV/HEX colors and opacity. Defaults are dark purple, 90% HSV saturation and 85% opacity. Disabling rendering keeps saved colors; missing per-pawn switches inherit the legacy global setting once. The duplicate pawn-gizmo color button was removed. Retains PNA, Bestow Bliss, Master qualification/progression, bonds and specializations from 2.4.1. Load Harmony and RJW before SSC; Binding Rituals require Ideology. Rabbit selection and legacy RimTalk remain unavailable. See the release notes for verification boundaries.
